stem: According to the chapter, what is the first function of a constitution?
options: To ensure that only good and honest people come to positions of power
To lay down the procedure for electing members of the national legislature
To guarantee every citizen an equal share of the property of society
To provide basic rules that allow minimal coordination among members of a society
explanation: Correct option: (D). The chapter states that the first function of a constitution is to provide a set of basic rules that allow for minimal coordination amongst members of a society. No constitution can ensure that good people come to power; election procedures relate to who decides, not this first function; and a constitution does not promise equal property.

stem: Why must the basic rules of a group be legally enforceable and not merely known to all?

Because enforceability gives everyone assurance that others will follow them
Because only enforceable rules can be written down in a single document

stem: A housing society has residents of different religions, incomes and ages who keep quarrelling over use of the common park. Following the reasoning of the chapter, what would first allow them to live together peacefully?

Asking each family to follow whatever rule it personally thinks is fair
